extracted.name: Chomorro coconut tatiyas
extracted.description: This is sort of a cross between pita and tortilla, best served with spicy dishes.
instruction_lines: In a bowl put all ingredients and mix well
Slightly knead and roll into small balls
Roll out into 1/8 of an inch pieces
In a dry pan heat each tatiya about 2 or 3 mins per side.
Serve with a nice spicy dish and enjoy.
